messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a tooltip hoverlink regression on KB pages (Chrome-ish). Hover shows the raw S3 shortlink instead of the resolved title. Seen on /kb/model-onboarding and a couple runbooks. cc @maya @samir

maya: saw this earlier in a QA pass, thought it was staging flakiness. Can you paste the page link + console snippets? :eyes:

alex: https://kb.redwood.ai/docs/model-onboarding (staging). Console shows 404 when trying to fetch /_shortlink/abc123 then the UI falls back and exposes the raw href. Minimal repro in console: 
```
GET https://kb.redwood.ai/_shortlink/abc123 404
// then tooltip code sets title = rawHref
```
Also build had a linter warning: "Warning: missing canonical for shortlink -> leaving as raw href"

samir: looks like shortlink-resolver worker failed its staging rollout this morning. Prod is fine. I'll check the worker logs and restart staging.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @samir for shortlink-resolver v3.2.1 to staging. ETA ~3m.

maya: even if worker comes back, cached KB pages could still show raw hrefs. Safer short-term: small UI guard to avoid printing raw S3 paths. @liz any chance you can shepherd a tiny CR? :pray:

liz: I can take a 10min CR. Proposed quick guard in kb-helpers.js: 
```
// before showing tooltip
if (!resolvedTitle) {
  element.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Link unavailable');
  element.classList.add('link-unavailable');
  continue; // skip showing raw href
}
```
Will add a unit test that mocks the resolver returning null.

alex: perfect. also add a small e2e that loads one page and asserts tooltip text does not contain 's3.amazonaws.com'.

liz: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kb/pull/987 — tiny guard + unit test + e2e. reviewers: @maya @samir. :shipit:

maya: reviewing now. left one nit about using i18n string for 'Link unavailable' so translators catch it.

samir: restarted the staging worker. Logs look healthy, no errors in the last 5m. Scheduling cache invalidation.

deploy-bot: Deploy successful to staging: shortlink-resolver v3.2.1. Invalidation job: started.

docs-bot: Added note to KB incident log: "shortlink tooltip regression" — TL;DR + PR link + staging verification steps.

alex: verified staging — tooltips now show 'Link unavailable' instead of raw s3 path. Verified in Chrome & Firefox. Thanks y'all. :tada:

maya: can we backport to prod once the prod e2e passes?

samir: yes. I'll run one more e2e and then schedule prod deploy tonight EOD with a short maintenance window.

alex: awesome. tagging this thread for follow-up: please post prod deploy + verification in this thread after rollout.

liz: will do. PR will be backported to release/1.8 after prod deploy.

(End of thread)
